subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should these MCP adapters guarantee one externally observable diagnostic format, or retain pipeline-specific identity while sharing only transport-neutral serialization?
rationale: The proposed extraction changes diagnostic ownership and its implied compatibility contract, but current source boundaries and discussion do not define identical output as intended behavior.

options.title: Share serialization only
options.body: Keep adapter-specific prefixes and context while extracting only a small invariant serializer with focused tests.

options.title: Define one log contract
options.body: Specify a common diagnostic schema and intentionally make both adapters emit it before centralizing the formatter.

options.title: Keep callbacks separate
options.body: Accept the small duplication because the adapters have different owners and no demonstrated drift cost.

recommendation.title: Share serialization only
recommendation.body: Keep adapter-specific prefixes and context while extracting only a small invariant serializer with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history most directly connects this person to the adjacent standalone MCP service architecture.
